market_pulse.note: About $58,780 at 4:36 PM ET Friday, down about 4.4% over 24 hours per CoinDesk; it was near $61,320 at 7:15 AM ET (CoinDesk; Fortune).
About $1,637 per CoinMarketCap late Friday, near its lowest since July; it was down about 7.6% over 24 hours by Friday morning (CoinMarketCap; CryptoTicker).
About $2.02 trillion, down about 5.8% over 24 hours, per CoinMarketCap (CoinMarketCap).
About 58.6% on CoinMarketCap's measure, down slightly on the day, with Ether at about 9.8% (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Bitcoin below $60,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell to a four-month low below $60,000 as U.S. tech stocks sold off and the Nasdaq dropped 5.3%; crypto-linked stocks such as Coinbase and Strategy also fell (CoinDesk; MarketScreener; AP).

themes.title: $1.4 billion liquidated
themes.summary: About $1.42 billion of leveraged positions were liquidated over 24 hours, about $1.3 billion of them longs, per CoinMarketCap (CoinMarketCap; CoinDesk).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had about $582 million of net outflows on Nov. 19, a third straight day of withdrawals (CryptoTicker; CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Fed hike expectations
themes.summary: Markets price a near-certain quarter-point Fed rate increase on Dec. 9 after hotter-than-expected October inflation, a headwind for risk assets (CoinStats; MarketScreener).

themes.title: Extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index read 8, in extreme fear, per CoinMarketCap, down from 11 on Nov. 19 per CoinStats (CoinMarketCap; CoinStats).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin near $58,780 and Ether near $1,637, both lower over 24 hours (CoinDesk; CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Miner IREN fell about 18%, Strive about 13% and Galaxy about 9% on Friday (CoinDesk).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: DeFi trading volume was about $13.2 billion over 24 hours, about 12% of all crypto volume (CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Stablecoins were among the steadiest assets, with Tether near $175 billion in market value and USDC near $69 billion, though total supply has been shrinking (CoinGecko; CoinStats).

watch_list.why: Analysts cite about $57,700 to $57,800 as Bitcoin's 2026 low and about $53,700 as its realized price, with resistance near $61,970 and $63,270 (The Crypto Basic).
MSCI is set to remove Strategy (MSTR), which holds about 850,849 BTC, from some U.S. indexes after the close on Nov. 30 (CoinStats).
Spot ETFs do not trade on weekends, and next week brings October PCE inflation data on Nov. 25 ahead of the Dec. 9 Fed decision (CryptoTicker; CoinStats).
